Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As the Enterprise Customer Success Leader, you are tasked with more than just facilitating the adoption of our technology. As a member of the broader Customer Success Leadership team, you will craft and execute a strategic vision for ensuring customers reach their desired outcomes, emphasizing scalability, process rigor, and the development of playbooks to fuel expansion and mitigate churn.

Through empathetic leadership and a focus on value, you will spearhead efforts to enhance renewal and expansion rates, manage and develop talent, and drive forward customer relationships with proactive engagement.

You will also play an integral part in helping to drive strategy and execution in how we deliver an end-to-end excellent customer experience.

What You'll Do

  • Lead by Example: Lead a dynamic customer success team towards exceptional performance, promoting a culture of accountability, execution, growth, and relentless improvement.

  • Scalability and Process: Develop and implement strategic improvements to drive scalable strategies and playbooks, ensuring a systematic approach to all stages of the customer journey, including: implementation, adoption, value realization, retention, and expansion.

  • Talent Coaching and Development: Inspire and mentor your team, elevating their capabilities to become strategic partners through influencing and advising decision makers and fostering customer advocacy.

  • Advance Customer Relationships: Deepen client engagements through strategic interactions, serving as an advisor and advocate for key stakeholders, driving advocacy, organic growth, and referrals.

  • Own Retention: introduce processes and early warning systems to reduce churn, mitigate risk, and ensure we are multi-threaded within customer accounts.

  • Effective Collaboration: Work with leaders across the broader GTM organization, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver the voice-of-customer and drive a culture of customer-centricity.

  • Product Feedback: Ensure we develop a feedback flywheel, turning customer insights into meaningful product enhancements and service optimizations.


What You Have

  • Leadership Experience: You are a natural leader, with a proven background in leading high performing customer success teams within late-stage or post-IPO Enterprise SaaS organizations, with a specific emphasis on “Strategic”, “Large Enterprise / Enterprise”, and/or top-tier / lighthouse accounts with multi-million dollar spend.

  • Strategic Acumen: Expertise in designing and executing customer success strategies that foster adoption, reduce churn, and promote expansion.

  • Empathy and Influence: A leadership style characterized by empathy, with a proven track record in team development through hiring, coaching, and fostering talent.

  • Outcome-Oriented: Exceptional ability to drive results through owning strategic initiatives, KPI reporting, and adept at navigating complex customer scenarios.

  • Communication Mastery: Superior communication skills, capable of effectively engaging and influencing at all organizational levels both internally, and externally.

  • Agility: Capacity to excel in a rapidly expanding, dynamic setting and swiftly adjust to evolving requirements.

  • Innovation: A genuine passion for technology and innovation, constantly seeking novel solutions to complex challenges.

Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us? We live #own(y)our growth and foster an environment in which innovation and personal development go hand in hand.

As Head of Finance & Accounting (all genders) you take ownership of the financial backbone of a company operating across five European markets, from financing and investment decisions to the systems and standards that let Finance scale with the business.


What to expect:

  • Leadership: Further scale our Finance & Accounting team, set the structure, priorities and standards of the function, and grow it in line with the requirements of a scaling European group

  • Business Partner: Serve as a strategic business partner to management and other internal stakeholders by evaluating the financial performance of our business lines or other investment opportunities, and support corporate finance processes

  • Stakeholder Management: Maintain strong relationships with lending banks, auditors and advisors, act as their primary point of contact, drive our financing and debt facilities, and support our Finance Director and Founders in investor communication and reporting

  • Reporting & Close: Own the integrity of our financial reporting across all entities, from monthly close and consolidation to the annual financial statements under HGB and the audit process, working closely with our Accounting Lead and external auditors

  • Tax & Compliance: Shape the tax structure of our European group: own the intercompany setup, assess the tax implications of new products, markets and entities, and bring complex questions to a decision

  • Finance Systems: Act as system owner for the Finance & Accounting tool stack (ERP, consolidation, treasury): define the target architecture, evaluate and select vendors, steer implementation projects, and ensure adoption and process quality after go-live

Inspire us by:

  • 6+ years of relevant professional experience, for example in a finance leadership role in a scaling company, transaction services, or investment banking

  • Proven leadership experience, with a track record of developing teams, setting ambitious goals, and driving cross-functional initiatives that established lasting standards across departments

  • An exceptional analytical mindset: you break down complex, ambiguous problems quickly and reach pragmatic, well reasoned answers

  • A solid grasp of German GAAP (HGB) and the ability to challenge and steer external advisors on accounting and tax matters

  • Confidence with finance systems and process design: you have led or substantially contributed to implementing an ERP, consolidation or reporting tool.

  • Excellent communication abilities, with the confidence and clarity to engage effectively across all levels of the organization, from C-level executives to project teams

  • Language skills: German at C1 or above and fluent English (C1)

What we offer:

  • Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday)

  • Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Neobank.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

data.description:
The Role

BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

data.description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you. 

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.


To help fuel that growth, we need a Rust Engineer to join our dynamic teams. 
 
This team is the beating heart of Prima. 
 
You’ll be joining over +350 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance.
 
Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What you’ll do
  • Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable and consistent services, writing reusable, modular, and maintainable code aligned with industry best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders, product managers, and engineering managers to translate business requirements into effective software solutions, define timelines, and estimate effort.
  • Perform code reviews, enforce coding standards, troubleshoot and debug complex issues, and ensure high code quality and performance.
  • Stay up to date with new technologies and tools, drive their adoption when appropriate, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and team growth.

    • What we’re looking for
  • Extensive experience in backend development, with solid knowledge of event-driven architectures, microservices, and domain-driven design.
  • Strong English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and accountable, with strong problem-solving skills and a growth mindset.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.

    • Nice-to-Have
  • Good knowledge of functional programming languages.
  • Professional experience with Rust and/or Elixir.
  • First-hand experience of test-driven development (TDD), Event-Sourcing and CQRS.
  • Experience with messaging systems such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.
    •  
    Why you’ll love it here:
     
    We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.
     
    🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

    🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

    🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

    Think you’re a match? Apply now.

     

    At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

    Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at ----- Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

data.description:
TALA has been on a rocket ship since its founding in 2019 by entrepreneur Grace Beverley. Built on largely organic social, today we are a digital-first, multichannel women’s activewear brand with a multifaceted growth and retention strategy.

Following a £5m fundraise from world-class institutional investors and growing global media attention, TALA is entering an exciting new phase of growth, including the opening of two stores in London.

Now, we’re taking TALA beyond London, and Bicester Village, you’re next.

*This will be for a FTC from November 26 to January 27*

Tasks

What you'll be doing

Goods In & Stock Flow

  • Own the end-to-end flow of stock from delivery to shop floor, taking full accountability for backroom performance.
  • Plan and manage delivery days around Bicester Village's service yard access and delivery windows, ensuring the team is resourced and ready ahead of every drop.
  • Receive, check and book in all deliveries accurately and on the day of arrival, escalating discrepancies, shortages and damages to Logistics within agreed timeframes.
  • Set and hold a clear delivery-to-floor turnaround standard

Processing, Pricing & Retail Ready

  • Own the "retail ready" standard end to end: steamed, sized, hung or folded, correctly hangered, security tagged, ticketed and floor-ready before it leaves the stockroom.
  • Manage the outlet pricing and ticketing process with total accuracy, ensuring every unit carries the correct price and any was/now ticketing is applied in line with brand and regulatory guidelines.
  • Execute promotional changes, markdowns and price changes to deadline, including overnight or pre-trade implementation where needed.
  • Build simple, repeatable processing routines and workstation set-ups that let the team move at volume without losing accuracy.
  • Track and improve processing productivity, using units-per-hour measures to plan labour and forecast the resource needed for peak drops.

Stock Accuracy & Inventory Integrity

  • Be the store's owner of stock file accuracy, treating the integrity of our data as a core deliverable rather than an admin task.
  • Run a disciplined cycle counting programme across the store, prioritising high-value, high-volume and known problem lines.
  • Investigate and resolve negative stock, unknown barcodes, duplicate barcodes and mis-scanning patterns, feeding root causes back to HQ rather than simply correcting the symptom.
  • Lead the store's preparation for and execution of full stocktakes, including pre-count housekeeping, team briefing, counting discipline and post-count exception resolution.
  • Own shrinkage performance for the store alongside the Store Manager, identifying loss drivers and putting practical controls in place.

Replenishment & Trading Support

  • Ensure the shop floor is fully sized and replenished at open, through the day and at close, so we never lose a sale to a size sitting in a box.
  • Partner with the Store Manager on floor moves, launches and campaign execution, making sure stock is available in the right quantity at the right moment.
  • Provide the Store Manager and Merchandising with clear, timely feedback on size and line performance, sell-through, over-stocks and gaps.
  • Support omnichannel fulfilment activity in store, including click and collect and any in-store fulfilment we introduce, to the service levels we set.

Backroom Management & Space

  • Design and maintain a stockroom layout that works at volume: logical, labelled, densely but safely stored, and quick to pick from.
  • Manage stockroom capacity actively, flagging space risk ahead of major intakes and working with HQ on solutions before it becomes a trading problem.
  • Own backroom housekeeping, packaging management, waste and recycling, in line with TALA's sustainability commitments.
  • Keep all equipment, consumables and ticketing supplies stocked and functioning.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop the stockroom team, building a small operation that takes genuine pride in pace, accuracy and standards.
  • Own rota planning for the backroom team, matching labour to the delivery schedule and trading peaks within payroll budget.
  • Recruit, onboard and train new team members on all BOH processes, and build stockroom capability across the wider store team.
  • Set clear daily targets and priorities, and hold the team to them through visible, on-the-floor leadership.

Compliance, Safety & Deputising

  • Ensure health and safety compliance across all back of house areas, including manual handling, safe stacking, fire exits and equipment checks, with regular audits and documented training.
  • Embed loss prevention procedures across goods in, stockroom and waste routines.
  • Ensure the store meets all Bicester Village centre operating standards and requirements.
  • Act as a key holder, opening and closing the store, and deputise for the Store Manager in their absence - including on trade, service and team decisions.

Requirements

About you:

  • Experience in a retail environment, preferably in fashion, activewear, or wellness—but above all, a genuine passion for these areas is a must.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, allowing you to connect effortlessly with customers and inspire your team.
  • A natural problem-solver—proactive, quick to learn, and able to thrive both independently and as part of a dynamic team.
  • Strong visual merchandising instincts, with a keen eye for detail to keep the store looking stylish and on-brand at all times.
  • Excellent multitasking skills, balancing customer service, sales, and store operations seamlessly in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in English (reading, writing, and speaking) to ensure clear and engaging customer interactions.
  • Passionate about building customer relationships, from discussing upcoming collections to gathering customer insights that foster long-term loyalty.

Benefits

Some of our core benefits include:

  • 28 days holiday a year inclusive of bank holidays
  • You'll be automatically enrolled in our company pension scheme with Aviva
  • Employee discount after probation period
  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • TALA Uniform

About us

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

Read about TALA's people, purpose and product work here.

data.description:
Launch your product career at Europe's leading music education platform

Matchspace Music is Europe's leading music education platform. We help thousands of music teachers build sustainable careers from teaching, and we are scaling fast across international markets. You will work directly with our VP Product.

This is a role for someone hungry. You want to see how a product is discovered, specified, built, shipped, measured and improved, and you want to be hands-on across the whole cycle. Everything we build follows one cycle: build, measure, learn, repeat. We are looking for a sharp analytical mind that is also creative in solving problems and providing fresh insights. In return you get a front-row seat in building AI-powered platforms, an AI-first way of working, and high visibility to the leadership team as we grow internationally.

Tasks

  • Feature conceptualization. Turn evidence into product ideas. You will run the full loop, from insight, to concept and options, to a sprint-ready story, and back to the data to see whether it worked.
  • Requirements engineering. Turn customer insights and support feedback into clear, buildable user stories with business context, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Own the qualification funnel so nothing rots and no ticket enters a sprint under-specified.
  • Sprint operations. Run backlog hygiene, standup and review mechanics, dependency flags and blocker tracking with our development team, so decisions get made once and stay made.
  • UAT, QA and testing. Own regression and release testing. Reproduce defects properly, keep the bug board honest, and support UAT and end-to-end dry runs.
  • Analytics and performance measurement. Own recurring KPI reporting across our tool stack, close measurement gaps, and turn funnel and cohort data into insight the team acts on. Every feature we ship is measured against the question: did it work? What was the impact?

Requirements

  • A relevant degree in business engineering, IT, information systems, digital business administration, or a related field, whether ongoing or recently completed.
  • Analytical and creative. You enjoy digging into data to find the real problem, and you are creative about how to solve it. Build-measure-learn is how you already think.
  • Structured and detail oriented. You find clean documentation and reproducible analysis satisfying, not tedious.
  • Comfortable with data. Excel/Sheets at a solid level, able to read dashboards, willing to learn fast
  • Comfortable and confident with software development technicalities, with viewing software code and understanding code with the help of AI
  • Proficient in German (min. B2) and English (C1). You can write a requirement someone else can build from. Your main operating language is English. German is essential for our Swiss home market.
  • Already using AI tools in your daily productivity workflow and genuinely curious about how software gets built.
  • Self-managing in a fast-moving, distributed team.

Nice to have

Agile/Scrum exposure, ticket systems, manual QA or test-case experience, and an interest in music, education or marketplaces.

Benefits

  • Work directly with the VP Product in a dynamic, cross-functional team spanning Product, Marketing and Customer Success.
  • Full end-to-end exposure: discovery, requirements, delivery, release, measurement and growth.
  • A front-row seat at Europe's leading music education platform, with real breadth across very different product challenges.
  • A modern, AI-first working culture.
  • A high-visibility talent role with direct exposure to the leadership team and an attractive international career trajectory as we scale.

We run a short, structured screening built around real examples of your work and how you think. Tell us who you are, why this role, and when you can start. We will take it from there.

  • Start: 15 September 2026

data.description:
Are you looking for challenges within an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? If so, now is the time to apply for our Internship Program in London.

Why United Media

We fundamentally believe our people are our greatest asset. At the company, you will work with incredible entrepreneurs who will push and guide you towards greatness. 

In short, we offer the brightest talents:

  • An opportunity to fast-track your career through responsibility for high-impact projects that constantly push you out of your comfort zone.
  • A chance to develop exceptional problem-solving, communication, and analytical skills.
  • You will use your interests and skills to have real influence—typically quite early in your career—and to solve the problems no one else can solve.
  • Hands-on experience building and scaling ventures together with the sharpest minds.
  • Networking Opportunities, Expand your professional network and forge meaningful connections with peers, mentors, and industry leaders.
  • Mentorship and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high-performing team as well as with the founder of our company, Mads Faurholt.

What roles are available

You'll be part of building and scaling companies, which, depending on your talent profile and interests, could entail responsibilities such as:

  • Being part of creating connections with key players from the industries we work in, such as CEOs, entrepreneurs, for example, co-founders of Airbnb, Apple, Starbucks etc. building and maintaining valuable relationships with them.
  • Drive revenue growth by getting involved in the commercial strategy and execution.
  • Expanding our audiences of senior industry professionals, investors, and future unicorn founders by defining and executing marketing strategies.
  • Strategically contribute to hyper-growing the team of talented and skilled team members.
  • Analyse the underlying metrics of the business to enable data-driven decisions.

What we expect from you

Our undergraduates join us from many backgrounds—there is no single "right" major or course of study. 

We believe in hiring talent and training for skills. We look for driven people with potential—we will teach you the rest.

Furthermore, we expect that you:

  • Are fluent in English, written and spoken. 
  • Have a UK working visa, or will obtain one by the start date
  • At university you were either:
    • The one who fought to get the best grades possible
    • The one who was tirelessly involved in extracurriculars/societies 

What comes after the internship

For exceptional performers, you will be considered for one of the few permanent positions as an associate in the firm. Staying in the firm beyond the internship is a springboard for achieving your career goal.

Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about finding or creating great stories and content? If so, you might be our next Senior Editor.

About us

United Media focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one. (Insurtech Insights, Presidents Summit, Private Equity Insights, HRtechX, CFO insights, Retail Insights and SetSales)

What we offer you

As our Senior Editor you have the unique opportunity to be part of building the greatest brand within Insurtech. By providing you with the ownership of our magazines, we want to constantly push you out of your comfort zone. You'll be working out of our HQ in London and to ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • An opportunity for getting operational experience in a scale-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matters to the business
  • A chance to work closely together with our CEO
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally

Your Responsibilities

Your responsibility will be to build the greatest physical magazine which entails that you:

  • Thoroughly research industry-related topics and ideas for stories and articles
  • Interview relevant people
  • Copywrite, write, edit and proofread content for our magazines
  • Construct the magazines including photos, design and artwork (with help from our Graphic Designer)

What we expect from you

You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you're humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you:

  • Have acquired a bachelor's degree with outstanding results preferably within journalism, communications, marketing, English, or related field
  • Have +5 years of work experience with outstanding performance from a magazine or media company
  • Have an UK work permit
  • Possess outstanding writing, editing and creative skills
  • Possess an exceptional attention to detail
  • Are well-organised and able to structure and prioritise your work

Startdate

Flexible

Monday - Friday we work from our office (next to Victoria Station) and do not offer remote work.

SetSales is Northern Europe's leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.

SetSales is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. 

What we offer you

As our Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You'll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.
  • Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.
  • Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you're equipped to do this in the best way possible.
  • Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.
  • Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.
  • Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.
  • Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands' progress.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

HRtechX are currently looking for a talented UX Designer to join our growing team.

  • Approaching briefs with conceptual attitude
  • Balancing across multiple projects
  • Passion and curiosity about the latest design innovations.
  • HTML, CSS knowledge is a plus
  • Agency experience is a plus

  • Communicative (you'll be emailing thousands of people where your message needs to come across clearly)

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Wordpress Web Developer.

About us

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one. 

What we offer you

As our Wordpress Web Developer you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our company website. You'll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact in a fast-growing business - You'll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work within a highly talented and motivated team.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your technical, interpersonal, organisation and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Improving the overall performance of our Wordpress website.
  • Developing an exceptional platform for the effective sharing of information between our business and the key stakeholders that we are targeting. 
  • Optimising the structure and display of existing and new information on our website.
  • Working cross functionally to identify and tackle business needs to drive its growth.
  • Quickly and effectively supporting our teams through any technical difficulties that they may experience.

What we expect from you

We are looking for a person to take full ownership over our Website's management. Thus, extensive knowledge of Wordpress is required - please share some examples of your work, we would love to see that!

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

Monday - Friday we work from our office (next to Victoria Station) and do not offer remote work.

data.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

data.description:
The Role

BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Principal Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

data.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API design and system behavior.

  • Maintain high App Store quality, stability, and production reliability.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of iOS development experience using Swift.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile apps.

  • Strong understanding of async/await, concurrency, and background tasks.

  • Solid iOS performance and memory optimization skills.

  • Experience shipping and maintaining production iOS apps.

  • Comfort designing for latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic AI behavior.

  • Exposure to CoreML or light on-device ML.

  • Familiarity with feature flags or remote configuration systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and user trust considerations.

 

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use iOS applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

 

Tech Stack

  • Swift

  • SPM

  • SwiftUI

  • SQL / noSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and scale n8n’s Service Partner ecosystem across the Southern Europe region, creating a strong network of consulting firms and systems integrators that drives partner-sourced pipeline, revenue growth, and customer success.

You’ll own the development of high-impact, long-term relationships with regional partners, helping them build successful service offerings around n8n and supporting our growth across Southern Europe.

Here’s how you’ll make that happen:

🔍 Acquire and qualify high-potential partners

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard consulting firms, boutique systems integrators, and digital agencies.

  • Build a strong understanding of the regional partner landscape and prioritize firms aligned with our go-to-market strategy.

  • Assess partner-market fit, technical capabilities, customer reach, and commercial potential.

  • Recruit partners motivated to build and scale dedicated automation and AI service offerings around n8n.

  • Develop relationships with senior stakeholders across partner organizations, from founders and practice leads to sales and delivery teams.

🧠 Enable, support, and scale partnerships

  • Design and deliver onboarding, enablement, and certification programs that help partners become commercially and technically successful.

  • Support partners in building internal n8n expertise, service packages, and repeatable implementation capabilities.

  • Create reusable resources, including playbooks, toolkits, templates, and best practices, to scale partner operations.

  • Drive partner education across technical, sales, and go-to-market tracks.

  • Help partners move from initial onboarding to active pipeline generation and customer delivery.

📈 Drive pipeline and co-selling success

  • Build, track, and grow partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline across the Southern Europe region.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to identify and activate opportunities.

  • Develop joint account plans and co-selling motions for strategic customers and prospects.

  • Co-own joint business plans with priority partners and ensure they deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Maintain clear visibility into partner performance, pipeline progression, and revenue contribution.

📣 Activate regional go-to-market initiatives

  • Plan and execute joint campaigns, webinars, events, and regional initiatives with partners.

  • Build strong relationships with local sales and field teams to ensure partners are embedded within regional go-to-market activity.

  • Co-create French-language content and marketing initiatives that increase awareness, engagement, and demand.

  • Represent n8n at relevant partner, industry, and technology events across the region.

  • Keep the partner ecosystem engaged through regular communication, updates, and community initiatives.

🌀 Champion partner feedback and continuous improvement

  • Act as the voice of partners internally, sharing insights that shape future programs, incentives, and product priorities.

  • Identify regional challenges and opportunities, and translate them into scalable improvements.

  • Use partner and performance data to improve the partner experience and increase operational efficiency.

  • Contribute to the evolution of n8n’s global partner program based on regional learnings.

  • Help define what excellent SI partnerships look like as n8n continues to scale.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 🚀 SaaS partnership experience: You have 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, alliances, or sales within fast-scaling SaaS or technology companies, including at least 3 years working directly with services partners as a quota-carrying individual contributor.

  • 🇫🇷 Fluent French and English: You are fluent in French and English and can confidently manage commercial negotiations, executive relationships, enablement sessions, and partner communications in both languages.

  • 🌍 Southern Europe market knowledge: You have a strong understanding of the French technology and consulting ecosystem, with an established network or proven experience developing relationships in the region.

  • 🤝 Partner recruitment and enablement: You have recruited, onboarded, and scaled high-performing consulting, agency, or systems integration partners.

  • 📈 Commercial ownership: You have owned partner-sourced pipeline or revenue targets and know how to move partnerships from relationship-building to measurable commercial results.

  • ⚡ High-growth mindset: You have thrived in fast-paced technology environments and know how to prioritize, execute, and make decisions in ambiguous situations.

  • 📣 Strong communicator and collaborator: You build trust quickly and influence senior internal and external stakeholders with clarity, credibility, and confidence.

  • 💻 Technical depth: You are comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, automation workflows, and the broader AI and automation landscape.

  • 🏗️ Builder’s mindset: You enjoy creating programs and processes from scratch rather than maintaining static playbooks. You are hands-on, data-driven, and focused on outcomes.

Nice-to-haves

  • 💼 Larger deal experience: You have supported partner-involved deals in the €100K to €500K range.

  • 🎯 GTM and co-sell experience: You understand regional go-to-market strategy, partner sales enablement, account mapping, and field collaboration.

  • 🔧 Industry knowledge: You have experience with iPaaS, workflow automation, AI, developer tools, or another technical SaaS platform.

  • 🏢 SI and enterprise experience: You have worked with systems integrators supporting complex software implementations for mid-market and enterprise customers.

  • 🌐 Regional network: You already have relationships with influential consulting firms, boutique SIs, digital agencies, or technology partners across the region.

About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company, revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.
We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe.


About the team

You will be working closely with the Flight Test Team and reporting to the Technical Director.


Your mission

As a Flight Test Engineer & Onsite Test Coordinator, you are the "Conductor of the Flight Line." Depending on your seniority, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of our flight test campaigns, from initial planning and hazard assessment to execution and deep-dive data analysis.
Beyond the technical data, you serve as the primary Onsite Leader. You are the person who ensures testing priorities are crystal clear to everyone on the range. You manage the daily tempo, coordinate the crew, and ensure that every person, from pilots to software engineers, knows exactly which tests are being conducted and when. Your mission is to transform raw flight data into actionable insights while maintaining a high-tempo, disciplined, and safe testing environment.




Responsibilities

Onsite Test Coordination & Leadership

  • Act as the Onsite Test Coordinator: Lead daily operations on the range, ensuring the team stays focused on the primary test objectives.
  • Clarify Priorities: Maintain and communicate the "Daily Flight Schedule," ensuring everyone knows the sequence of events and current testing priorities.
  • Lead Briefings: Drive the morning "Pre-Flight Brief" and the evening "Debrief," capturing critical feedback and setting goals for the following day.
  • Resource Management: Coordinate the availability of airframes, ground support equipment, and personnel to maximize range time efficiency.
Flight Execution & Safety
  • Coordinate and execute UAV flight tests in compliance with regulatory requirements and STARK safety standards.
  • Ensure all flight activities and anomalies are documented with high fidelity.
  • Develop specific Flight Test Techniques (FTTs) and instrumentation requirements to capture critical performance metrics.
  • Lead Flight Readiness Reviews (FRR) and contribute to safety review boards.
Test Design & Data Analysis
  • Develop comprehensive flight test plans, test cards, and rigorous flight test hazard assessments (FTHA).
  • Process and analyze flight data using MATLAB or Python to validate system performance against requirements.
  • Work closely with Ardupilot and PX4-based flight control systems to iterate on flight behavior and performance.
  • Manage the configuration of flight test articles, ensuring all hardware and software versions are meticulously tracked.


Qualifications

Educational & Legal Background

  • Degree: Bachelor’s or higher in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering.
  • NATO Citizenship: Must be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations).
  • Communication: Professional-level written and verbal English.
Technical & Leadership Toolkit
  • Coordination Skills: Proven ability to lead a technical team on-site (three pilots and one engineer), manage schedules, and communicate priorities clearly under pressure.
  • Data Mastery: Practical experience in data reduction and analysis using MATLAB or Python.
  • UAV Systems: Familiarity with Ground Control Stations (GCS), telemetry systems, and mission planning tools.
  • Testing Rigor: Proven ability to plan and conduct system-level tests in an aerospace or defense environment.
Mindset & Style
  • The "General" Mindset: You are naturally organized and can work through ambiguity on the flight line.
  • Analytical & Decisive: You can analyze a data anomaly quickly and decide whether to continue testing.
  • Meticulous Documenter: You believe that if it wasn't documented with high fidelity, the test never happened.
Preferred Experience
  • Active experience with uncrewed aviation.
  • Hands-on experience with flight test instrumentation (FTI) and DAQ systems.
  • Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation environments.

For more details:
Please reach out to Sally Grütte-Pad, Interim Lead TA Partner via -----

Intro

Die CKM Group bündelt Expertise aus verschiedenen Bereichen, um Fortschritt und Innovation in der Gesundheitsversorgung voranzutreiben. Unser Zusammenschluss aus Klinik, Labor, telemedizinischem Service und IT-Unternehmen steht für die Entwicklung moderner und effektiver Lösungen im Gesundheitswesen.

Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denkenGesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo.

Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist GreenMedical: Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service bieten wir einen einfachen und sicheren Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis, um Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität zu verbessern. Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Patienten bereits heute mit modernen Lösungen zur medizinisch begleiteten Gewichtsreduktion. Perspektivisch planen wir, unser Angebot um weitere Präventions- und Gesundheitsleistungen zu erweitern, um noch mehr Menschen individuell auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Gesundheit und Lebensqualität zu begleiten.

Deine Mission bei uns

  • Steuerung unseres Marketing-Projektportfolios: Du planst, priorisierst und steuerst mehrere Marketingprojekte gleichzeitig – von Produkt- und Vertical-Launches über Kampagnen und Messeauftritte bis hin zu strategischen C-Level-Sonderprojekten. Dabei koordinierst du alle Beteiligten, behältst Timelines im Blick und sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung.

  • Steuerung externer Partner: Du koordinierst unsere Agenturen und Dienstleister, formulierst präzise Briefings, steuerst Feedbackprozesse und stellst sicher, dass alle externen Leistungen optimal mit unseren internen Teams abgestimmt sind.

Durch standardisierte Templates, Playbooks und effiziente Workflows sorgst du dafür, dass Marketingprojekte schneller, strukturierter und in gleichbleibend hoher Qualität umgesetzt werden.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Marketing-Projektmanagement: Du hast bereits eigenverantwortlich komplexe Marketingprojekte, Kampagnen oder Produkt-Launches geleitet und kannst konkrete Erfolge anhand messbarer Ergebnisse belegen.

  • Ausgeprägte Projektmanagement-Kompetenz: Du verstehst es, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu steuern, komplexe Vorhaben in klare Arbeitspakete zu strukturieren und unterschiedliche Stakeholder erfolgreich zu koordinieren. Dabei arbeitest du sicher mit klassischen und agilen Projektmanagement-Methoden.

  • Mehrjährige Marketing-Erfahrung: Du verfügst über mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Marketing, idealerweise im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld. Das Zusammenspiel von Performance Marketing, CRM, Content und Conversion ist dir bestens vertraut und du verstehst, wie erfolgreiche Marketingprojekte kanalübergreifend umgesetzt werden.

  • Kommunikationsstärke & strategisches Denken: Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf, formulierst überzeugende Briefings und Entscheidungsvorlagen und kommunizierst souverän mit internen Teams, Agenturen und dem Management.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität & Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Projekte mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch erfolgreich zum Abschluss. Auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit wechselnden Prioritäten behältst du den Überblick.

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im Startup- oder HealthTech-Umfeld: Erfahrungen in schnell wachsenden Startups oder Scale-ups sowie Kenntnisse regulierter Märkte wie HealthTech oder Telemedizin sind ein Plus. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Tools wie Figma oder Adobe sowie ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung runden dein Profil ab.

data.description:
Your mission

VIDA's Data Solutions team delivers geospatial analytics and software that inform sustainable infrastructure development worldwide - spanning energy, climate resilience, roads, health and other sectors.
We're growing the team with a geospatial data engineer who brings strong engineering fundamentals to hands-on geospatial data work at scale. You'll implement, tailor and extend existing methodologies for customer projects and pilots across our sectors, and help grow our agentic AI capabilities for both internal and client-facing use. You'll contribute to client-facing deliverables and discussions alongside a project manager who owns the client relationship, and you'll work closely with our Technology team when it comes to extending our agentic capabilities.


What you'll do

  • Apply and customize geospatial methodologies across our sectors at scale, working with a wide range of geospatial, climate, satellite imagery, and other datasets.
  • Contribute to project deliverables — analytical outputs, documentation, and reports — and engage in customer-facing project discussions alongside a project manager.
  • Work with our software platform as part of project delivery, and help extend our agentic AI capabilities for internal and client-facing use, alongside our senior ML engineer.


Is it you we’re looking for?

  • Background: Degree and/or professional experience in geospatial data engineering, data science, computer science, AI, or a related technical or scientific field.
  • Experience: 2–5 years combining software/data engineering with geospatial applications, ideally including experience in climate, energy, and/or infrastructure.
  • Technical skills: Proficiency in Python, experience in software engineering, including latest developments in agentic development, and geospatial data engineering.
  • AI-forward mindset: Genuine enthusiasm for using and building with AI tools.
  • Applied project experience: Some experience delivering technical work within client projects, adapting to shifting priorities and timelines.
  • Customer-facing skills: Comfortable communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and contributing to client discussions and deliverables.
  • Flexibility: Comfortable in a dynamic environment, moving between projects across sectors as well as broader technical development as priorities shift.
  • Bonus: GCP, geospatial tools, climate / natural hazard modelling experience, extended knowledge in one of VIDA’s core sectors; broader software/data engineering skills.


What we offer

  • Mission & impact: Create tangible real-world impact, and shape our success story and culture from the ground up.
  • Diversity: 15+ nationalities on the team, spread across the globe.
  • VSOP program: All team members share in VIDA's success.
  • Remote & flexible: Autonomy over where you work remotely (+/- 4h to Germany’s time zone). We also have offices in Nairobi and Munich.
  • Budgets: 500€/year for learning/wellbeing, 500€ for equipment setup.
  • 28 vacation days + public holidays in your country of residence.


Sounds exciting?

Submit your application directly via the job advertisement. When applying, please state your expected salary in gross EUR/USD per year.
Learn more at vida.place or on LinkedIn.
We're looking forward to receiving your application! In case your experience doesn't fit all of the criteria, get in touch anyway.

In der Rolle des Online Marketing Managers (m/w/d) kalkulierst und steuerst du die Werbebudgets unserer Kunden. Ziel ist es die bestmögliche Sichtbarkeit mit einem vorgegebenen Budget zu erreichen. Um die Fortschritte der Arbeit auch dem Kunden zu übermitteln, werden regelmäßig Auswertungen erstellt. Auch die Positionierung der Produkte an gewünschten Werbeplätzen spielt hierbei eine große Rolle.🚀

Aufgaben

  • Strategieerarbeitung: Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Account Managern, um Werbepotenziale auf Amazon optimal auszuschöpfen und auszubauen.
  • Keyword-Recherche & SEO-Optimierung: Durchführung von Keyword-Recherchen sowie On- und Offpage-Analysen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kampagnenleistung.
  • Kampagnenoptimierung: Maximierung des Kampagnenpotenzials durch fortlaufende Optimierung und Überwachung der Kampagnen, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
  • Datenanalyse & Maßnahmenableitung: Analyse der Kampagnendaten mit Hilfe von Analyse-Tools und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Performance.
  • Reporting: Aufbau und Pflege von Reportings zur transparenten Dokumentation der Ergebnisse und Erfolge der Kampagnen für den Kunden.
  • Amazon Seller Central: Nutzung und Verwaltung des Amazon Seller Central zur Überwachung und Steuerung von Kampagnen.
  • PPC-Optimierung: Anpassung und Optimierung der PPC-Preise auf Basis zuvor festgelegter Strategien, um die Effizienz und den ROI der Werbemaßnahmen zu maximieren.

Qualifikation

  • Kaufmännische Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Kaufmann/-frau für E-Commerce oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich.
  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und bist in der Lage, Aufgaben effizient und selbstständig zu bewältigen.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themenfelder einzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge zu verstehen.
  • Team- und Kommunikationsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist in der Lage, dich klar und präzise schriftlich sowie mündlich zu äußern.
  • Analytisches Denken: Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Zahlen und die Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen, zeichnen dich aus.
  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Deine schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation ist klar und gut organisiert.
  • Technisches Know-how: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint gehören zu deinem Repertoire, um Kampagnenanalysen und Präsentationen professionell zu erstellen.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.

data.description:
In dieser Position bist du für die operative Umsetzung unseres Google-Marketings zuständig. Während die Strategie und das technische Setup vorgegeben werden, verantwortest du das fehlerfreie Einbuchen, die tägliche Pflege und das exakte Monitoring unserer Google-Ads-Kampagnen. Du hältst dem Team im Tagesgeschäft den Rücken frei, überwachst die Budgets nach klaren Vorgaben und bereitest die Performance-Daten in übersichtlichen Reportings auf. Durch deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Kampagnen verlässlich laufen und optimiert werden.

Aufgaben

  • Kampagnen-Setup & Pflege: Du buchst Google-Ads-Kampagnen (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) nach klaren Vorgaben ein und pflegst Anzeigen, Texte sowie Budgets im System.
  • Tägliches Monitoring: Du überwachst laufend die Performance und die Tagesbudgets unserer Accounts, um einen reibungslosen und fehlerfreien Ablauf der Kampagnen sicherzustellen.
  • Datenpflege & Reporting: Du exportierst regelmäßig die Leistungsdaten der Werbekampagnen und bereitest diese in übersichtlichen Excel-Listen oder Dashboards für das Management auf.
  • Operatives Tagesgeschäft: Du unterstützt bei der täglichen Organisation der Marketing-Aktivitäten, übernimmst die Abstimmung von Werbemitteln (wie Bildern und Texten) und erledigst anfallende Routineaufgaben im Account.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung oder Studium: Du bringst ein abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften) oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung mit.
  • Erste Marketing-Einblicke: Du hast erste praktische Erfahrungen im digitalen Marketing gesammelt (z. B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder erste Berufsschritte).
  • Google-Kenntnisse als Plus: Idealerweise hast du schon mal mit Google Ads oder Analyse-Tools gearbeitet – das ist ein großer Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du Lust hast, dich schnell in diese Systeme einzuarbeiten.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du bist absolut zuverlässig, arbeitest extrem gewissenhaft und prüfst deine Aufgaben lieber doppelt, bevor etwas online geht.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen: Du hast eine gute Affinität zu Daten und kannst sicher mit Excel oder Google Sheets umgehen, um Listen und Tabellen zu pflegen.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.

data.title: Junior Google Performance & Analytics Manager (m/w/d)

data.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust APIs including public TTS API, internal APIs like Payment, Subscription, Auth and Consumption Tracking, ensuring they meet business and scalability requirements
  • Oversee the full backend API landscape, enhancing and optimizing for performance and maintainability
  • Collaborate on B2B solutions, focusing on customization and integration needs for enterprise clients
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to align backend architecture with overall product strategy and user experience

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Proven experience in backend development: TS/Node (required)
  • Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers
  • Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
  • Preferred: Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
  • Preferred: Proficiency in deploying high availability applications on Kubernetes

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Germany Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-120,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? 

Refer them!
